categories.main_business_segments: North Long Dragon New Materials Tech Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of non-metallic composite materials for military vehicle equipment. Its main product lines include human-machine environment system interiors for military vehicles, ammunition equipment, auxiliary military vehicle equipment, military vehicle communication equipment, and unmanned aerial vehicles (drones). The products are widely applied in electronic information, armored combat, and armored support vehicles, focusing on enhancing mobility, safety, reliability, and environmental adaptability of military vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in advanced non-metallic composite materials, particularly resin-based composites reinforced with fibers such as carbon fiber and glass fiber. Key manufacturing technologies include vacuum infusion, prepreg vacuum bag molding, prepreg molding, online impregnation molding, and hand lay-up processes. The company emphasizes customized product design, structural and process engineering, and has developed proprietary technologies in lightweighting, modular integration, flame retardancy, and composite material shielding for military applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are domestic military equipment general assembly enterprises affiliated with China's top ten military industrial groups. The end markets are mainly the Chinese military sectors including the army, navy, rocket forces, and other defense branches. Products are integrated into main battle armored vehicles such as wheeled and tracked armored reconnaissance, command, infantry fighting vehicles, and tanks, as well as naval vessels, aerospace, electronic warfare, and logistics support equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: North Long Dragon operates mainly within China, with significant sales concentrated in the North China region, followed by East China, Central China, Northwest China, Southwest China, and Northeast China. The company’s registered and operational headquarters are located in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, within the National Civil Aerospace Industrial Base. There is no indication of overseas operations or sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the military composite materials supply chain. It functions as a specialized supplier of composite material components and assemblies for military vehicles, collaborating closely with military research institutes and general assembly enterprises. It procures raw materials such as fibers and resins from upstream suppliers and focuses on customized design, manufacturing, and integration of composite parts into final military equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation aligned with military modernization and national defense needs, focusing on lightweight, high-strength composite materials for military vehicles. R&D efforts include developing multifunctional human-machine environment system interiors, advanced composite ammunition containers, protective composite components, and composite antenna radomes with enhanced impact resistance. It actively participates in drafting national military standards and expands into new product lines such as unmanned aerial vehicles and modular composite shelters, supported by a growing, highly skilled R&D team.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized composite material products to military general assembly enterprises under long-term contracts. The company participates in military research projects during the prototype and development phases, transitioning to batch production supply contracts upon product standardization and military acceptance. Sales are conducted via a direct sales model, with revenue recognized upon product delivery and acceptance by customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: North Long Dragon holds a leading position in the niche market of non-metallic composite materials for military vehicle interiors and related equipment in China. It benefits from early entry advantages, established military qualifications, strong customer relationships, and participation in national military standards development. The military composite materials sector is characterized by high entry barriers and limited competition, with the company maintaining a competitive edge through technological innovation and deep integration with military clients.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 107.7 million, a 20.13% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 10.89 million, reversing from a profit in 2023. Total assets stood at about RMB 1.24 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.13 billion. The company’s revenue and profit declined due to delayed military contract acceptance and increased credit impairment losses. Despite short-term setbacks, the company maintains a solid asset base and continues investing heavily in R&D, with expenditures exceeding 21% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by offering high-performance, lightweight, and durable non-metallic composite materials tailored for military vehicle applications, enhancing vehicle mobility, safety, and operational reliability under harsh conditions. Its products integrate advanced material properties such as flame retardancy, impact resistance, electromagnetic shielding, and environmental adaptability. The firm’s deep military domain expertise, early market entry, comprehensive military qualifications, and close collaboration with military research institutions provide strong customer trust and long-term strategic partnerships.
